summary: Independent BETA discovery pass confirms the AV regulatory regime is moving in two directions at once: NHTSA is reducing design-rule friction for purpose-built AVs while actively auditing Cybercab self-certification. This is a material regime/constraint-migration signal for autonomy, but the cadence-due discovery family review is not complete, so discovery remains incomplete and no canonical score/rank influence is proposed.

materialFindings.finding: NHTSA opened an Audit Query on September 4, 2026 into Tesla Cybercab self-certification after commercial Austin deployment, specifically testing whether a vehicle without traditional human controls satisfies applicable FMVSS. This is primary evidence that AV commercialization now carries active certification/enforcement risk even as rules are being modernized.

NHTSA separately announced rulemaking to remove manual-control requirements such as brake pedals for ADS-only vehicles while preserving braking performance requirements. Together with the Cybercab audit, the signal is regulatory transition rather than simple deregulation.

BIS regulatory surfaces were current through September 10-11, 2026 in this pass, but no newly verified same-day company-specific export-control event was established. Export-control regime risk therefore remains a monitored sensor rather than a new canonical event.

contradictions.issue: The AV policy signal cannot be summarized as uniformly permissive: exemption/rule modernization and active compliance enforcement coexist.

unknowns: Full cadence-due review of SEC EDGAR, NYSE, Nasdaq IPO, Cboe, FINRA OTC Daily List and USAspending was not reproduced in this pass.
Weekly sensor sweep across NIH RePORTER, NSF awards, CISA KEV, FAA commercial space, EPA ECHO, DOJ, FTC and USPTO was not completed in this pass.

Important 2036 dependency with incomplete instrumentation: certification/regulatory throughput for purpose-built autonomous systems is not yet represented as a dedicated metric/graph node across the autonomy universe.

peerRequests.request: Test whether AV certification/regulatory throughput should become a causal constraint node distinct from technical autonomy capability; do not promote without entity-level corroboration.
